name: Coforge Ltd
about: Coforge is an IT services company providing end-to-end software solutions and services. . It is among the top-20 Indian software exporters. Prominent global customers include British Airways, the ING group, SEI Investments, Sabre, and SITA. Over the years, Coforge has set up subsidiaries in the US, Singapore, Australia, UK, Germany and Thailand, mainly to market and mobilise projects for the software division. The company has business partnerships with large IT companies across the world.

bull.point: Revenue growth is accelerating, reaching 53.7% year-over-year in the most recent quarter.
Profitability is scaling efficiently, with annual EBITDA margins expanding from 16% to 18% over three years.
The company demonstrates strong cash generation, converting 113% of five-year profits into operating cash flow.
bull.basis: 113% of 5-yr profit converted to operating cash

bear.point: Total borrowings surged significantly to ₹6,026 Cr in the most recent period.
Current EBITDA margins of 19% and 20% are tracking below the full-year guidance of 20.5%–21%.
Quarterly net profit volatility remains high, dropping from ₹666 Cr to ₹532 Cr in one quarter.
